pearls.purpose: Setup + admin Pearl for the Apache Fineract back-end that ccash and adjacent operator tools talk to via the fineract-sidecar. Configures the Fineract base URL, tenant credentials, chart-of-accounts, and revocation rules; issues a FineractAdmin capability that ccash claims to push settlements.

sidecars.label: HTTP Component
sidecars.purpose: All Fineract API traffic flows through this sidecar — operator credentials are kept off the Pearl.

offers.name: fineract-admin
offers.purpose: Issue a settlement-capable cap that ccash + wholesale operator pearls claim to push transactions.

adminOnly.name: Configure Fineract endpoint + creds
adminOnly.purpose: OTP-gated; rotates the tenant credentials in the sidecar.

adminOnly.name: Issue / revoke FineractAdmin caps
adminOnly.purpose: Decide which operator pearls have settlement authority.

httpOut.purpose: Fineract REST API for setup + per-settlement push.

interfaces.name: Fineract.Admin@1
interfaces.purpose: Issue a settlement-capable cap that ccash + wholesale operator pearls claim to push transactions.

incomingApi.purpose: Admin cap consumed by ccash + wholesale operator pearls.
